visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female pianist wearing a silver, bomb-shaped metallic helmet with sharp teeth and a dorsal fin sits at a black grand piano. She is dressed in a white sleeveless top and a black mini-skirt with high black stockings. Her hands move across the piano keys in a studio setting with blue vertically-pleated curtains as a backdrop and bright, even studio lighting. (2) The video frame is split; the top half displays a montage of animated scenes from an anime featuring characters in a cafe and rainy urban environments, while the pianist continues her performance below. The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot, focusing on the pianist's upper body and hands. (3) The animation sequences in the top half shift to high-action battle scenes with bright yellow and red fire effects. The pianist's hand movements become more rapid and forceful to match the visual intensity. (4) The visuals transition back to calmer, more melancholic anime scenes of a girl walking through a dark alleyway at night. The pianist maintains her steady posture, finally finishing the piece with a graceful hand lift from the keyboard.

There are no vocals or electronic textures present. The room acoustics suggest a dry, professional studio environment with high spectral clarity. (2) A subtle mechanical click or percussive transient is heard as the pianist shifts registers, followed by an increase in harmonic density and volume. The tempo remains stable at approximately 128 BPM, but the playing becomes more aggressive and expressive. (3) The music transitions into a faster sequence with rapid piano runs and accented low-frequency notes. The dynamic range is wide, capturing the subtle nuances of the keystrokes against a very clean background floor. (4) The piece ends with a series of sustained chords that slowly decay into a pristine silence, with no lingering ambient noise or artifacts.
